source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current decryptArray JSDoc still calls encrypted_array a string, but decrypt supplies a ctypes uint8_t array. Treat this as an unresolved documentation mismatch. Proposed manual rule: describe the concrete representation at foreign-library boundaries and keep the helper name, parameter type and caller consistent. A standard spelling or formatter check cannot establish that a parameter description matches the value. Do not copy this historical string annotation into new byte-array APIs.
title: Document the actual value passed into a byte-array helper
